title: Valued CSP of a template
statement: Let $\Psi$ be a constraint satisfaction template over domain $D$. Its associated valued CSP consists of all functions obtained from a predicate $p$ of $\Psi$ by pairing that predicate's arity with its unsatisfied cost function.
hypotheses_covered: A CSP template $\Psi$ over domain $D$ is given
